scope: External diagnostic proposal verification only. Full-source unsigned arm64 iOS Simulator Debug/Release builds and Foundation-only extracted-gate fixture; no production adoption or actual log-capture result.

proposal.goal: Record only the winning photo-inspection terminal decision as a fixed reason and numeric error code, without changing public statuses, classifier/amount behavior or OCR instrumentation. This does not diagnose the earlier unavailable result.

fullSourceCompile.target: arm64 generic iOS Simulator; code signing disabled

literalStringBoundary.scope: Hash-bound binary string inspection only; not emission, retrieval, flushing, retention, privacy or runtime proof.

observedChecks: Frozen file/source/binary bindings and all 20 row/order/42 schedule observations matched fixed expectations: returned value, registrations, stub cancellation counts and candidate fixed-event payloads. Baseline and OCR-shaped schedules emitted no photo events. G17 independently permits either valid race winner; identical winners across independent runs are not required.
boundaries: G03 uses a synthetic empty final-snippet payload; it does not prove reachability after real filtering. G06/G07 are source-only mappings, with no image condition or branch execution.
G18 is OCR-shaped generic-gate behavior; G19 uses separate per-view gates and source-only aggregation rather than actual image TaskGroup execution.
G20 replaces the logger with an in-memory sink. Its 12 fixed reason/Int payloads and sentinel exclusion do not establish actual OSLog emission, capture, retention or release privacy.

Injected deadline ordering does not test the production 12-second timers. Request stubs do not establish actual Vision cancellation or OS computation release; one controlled race per flavor is not stress/reliability acceptance.

Events occur outside the gate lock after continuation delivery. A consumer can resume before its event appears; absent logs cannot prove an absent branch, and there is no per-view identifier for correlation.
Retained compiler/hash receipts bind the observed builds; this review did not reproduce builds or audit every machine-wide execution. Watchdog/crash/timeout failure paths were not exercised.
pending: Separately approved fixed-event OSLog emission/capture verification using a retained retrieval route.
Any source adoption and actual app/classifier integration require separate review and evidence.
Recognition quality, full photo journey, accessibility, physical offline, clinical/applicant and Swift Challenge readiness remain open.
privacy: No binaries, pixels, raw logs, saved-record content, private absolute paths or account/device identifiers copied into this repository. Source and local artifact metadata/hashes only. Preparation freezes retain their original uncompiled/unrun state; the later observations are recorded separately here.
localArtifactReferencesResolution: Resolve from this JSON directory; raw evidence stays outside the repository and playground.
